pages.text: These are the primary components of AE2 input and output $(l:ae2_mechanics/devices)devices$(/l). Using the power of $(l:items_blocks_machines/fluix_crystal)Fluix Crystal$(/l) and a $(l:items_blocks_machines/processors)logic processor$(/l) it allows devices to input and output items, blocks, fluids, etc. (No actual function, just a crafting intermediate)
